title: Pan-Seared Barramundi with Polish Flair
description: A delicious and aromatic dish that combines the flavors of Poland with the freshness of barramundi.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the barramundi fillets with salt and black pepper.
Add the barramundi to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, slice the Polish sausage into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
Once the barramundi is cooked, remove it from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced sausage to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Serve the barramundi with the sausage and a side of toasted rye bread.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
